title: Trustabl — tool_loop
description: Grafana/Tempo translation of the trustabl.tool_loop runtime rule (rules/tool_loop.yaml). Hand-authored worked example, not generated by tooling. See README.md in this directory for the field-by-field mapping.

panels.title: trustabl.tool_loop — execute_tool spans with trustabl fingerprint
panels.description: Plain TraceQL search: all execute_tool spans with trustabl.tool.input_fp set. Rows sharing the same input_fp value within one run_id are the loop signal — three or more identical fingerprints in a 5-call window is the tool_loop condition (rules/tool_loop.yaml). The demo trace produces rows 1, 3, 4 with input_fp=73bc9922f0f68bb2.

options.content:
**trustabl.tool_loop** fires when `count_same(trustabl.tool.input_fp) >= 3` within the last 5 `execute_tool` calls in a run, where `trustabl.tool.side_effect != none`.

The automated alert rule is defined in `alert-rule.yaml` (same directory). When provisioned via Grafana's alerting provisioning, it fires automatically — no manual counting needed. Alert state changes appear as annotations on the table above (red markers on the time axis).

The demo trace (`local_agent_ollama_demo.py`) issues the same query (and thus the same `input_fp`) at steps 1, 3, and 4 — three occurrences — which is exactly the threshold. Severity: **high** per `rules/tool_loop.yaml`.
